node.statement: The sets G and B split the positive indices according to whether d_j>tau/4 or d_j<=tau/4, while a_j^+=0 for nonpositive indices. Thus sum_j a_j^+=sum_{j in G} a_j^+ + sum_{j in B} a_j^+. Using sum_j a_j^+=1+nu from 1.1 and sum_{j in G} a_j^+=sigma_g from 1.4.1.3.1 gives sum_{j in B} a_j^+=1+nu-sigma_g.
